text: How many pilot sites are confirmed (name, town, type)? Who is the contact at each?
why: Decides how many stands we make and how much content we prepare before the pilot.

text: Who will write each site's concierge content: the owner, the client, or us? (Drives the CMS editor scope.)
why: Decides whether we build a simple form for owners or write the content for them.

text: Languages needed at launch (EN / AF / DE / other)?
Can we get each pilot's logo, brand colours, 5–10 photos, Wi-Fi, breakfast/checkout times, house rules, WhatsApp number, Google Review link?
Is the Whale Coast Directory a site the client owns? Does it have an API, database or export we can use?
Who curates "things to do" (hikes, restaurants, events) for the pilot, and is there existing data (spreadsheet, brochure, site)?
Which legal entity owns TapIt (company name, reg. number, VAT status)? Is the business forum involved, and how?
why: The company name goes on the invoices, the terms and the privacy policy.

text: Who owns the domain, GitHub org, VPS and payment accounts?
why: We need to know who holds the keys before we set anything up.

text: Existing brand assets (logo, colours, fonts) for TapIt, or do we design them?
Tone: premium/adventurous, or friendly/local? Any competitor or site the client loves visually?
What will pilot sites pay: setup fee, monthly fee, free, or sponsored? Any price already promised?
why: The pricing model decides how billing is built, so it must be settled early.

text: Commission: fixed % per operator or per-booking negotiable? Who collects the guest's money: TapIt, or the operator directly?
why: Commission only works if we can trace and verify bookings. This shapes the billing flow.

text: Payouts: how often and by what method (EFT)? Does the client want TapIt to hold funds, or only invoice commission after the fact?
Is TapIt VAT-registered? Which invoices/statements must the system produce?
Royalties: what are they exactly (e.g. share to the forum or sponsors)? Who pays whom, and on what basis?
Has the client taken legal/accounting advice on acting as a booking agent or tour operator (including indemnity, cancellation, consumer protection)?
NFC stand supplier, unit cost, order lead time, and who programs/prints the units?
why: Stand cost and lead time decide the setup fee and how soon pilot sites can go live.

text: Stand size and materials (acrylic, wood)? Branded per site or generic TapIt plus site logo?
Who is the Information Officer, and is registration with the Information Regulator done?
why: POPIA requires a named Information Officer before we collect any guest data.

text: What guest data do we need at pilot: none (anonymous analytics), or email/phone for passport and offers?
Who provides the privacy policy and terms, or do we draft them for legal review?
Support: who answers a guesthouse owner when something breaks, and what hours?
VPS spec/provider/location (ZA data residency preferred). Is Portainer already installed?
why: We need the server details before we can deploy the pilot.

text: Who controls DNS for tapit.info and can it point to the VPS?
why: We need control of the domain name to put the pilot site on it.

text: Email provider for system mail (transactional)? Any existing mailbox or domain setup?
Which payment gateway does the client already have an account with?
Are there existing booking systems operators use (Checkfront, Bookeo, FareHarbor, other) that we should integrate with?
Is there a budget for map/tile services and for an external penetration test?
3D = replaying a trip over 3D terrain plus phone tracking (not a 3D UI). Pilot gets a featured-trail flyover from admin-uploaded GPX; user tracking is phase 2. Agreed?
why: The 3D trip replay is the most demanding feature. We want to confirm the scope.

text: Do we have GPX/route data for the trails, and are the rights cleared?
Who funds the Passport prizes (for example the Kogelberg Explorer prize): sponsors, partners, or the forum?
Can partners add the TapIt referral code at their own checkout, or must they confirm each booking by hand in the portal?
why: This decides whether referrals can be matched automatically or need manual checking.

text: How should cancellations and chargebacks affect commission? For example, a credit note against the next invoice.
For long hikes, is it acceptable that phone tracking pauses when the screen is off, with GPX import from a watch as the fallback?
why: Browsers pause location tracking in the background. The alternative is a native app, which is a later and larger step.

text: How long may we keep a guest's recorded trip points? We propose 12 months, then delete.
why: POPIA says personal information must not be kept longer than needed.
